\title[Symbolic Wavefunctions and Entropic Fractals]{Symbolic Wavefunctions and Entropic Fractals: A Structural--Analogical Heuristic for Socio--Symbolic Dynamics}

\author*[1]{\fnm{Demetrios} \sur{Agourakis}}\email{demetrios@agourakis.med.br}
\affil[1]{\orgname{Faculdade São Leopoldo Mandic}, \orgaddress{\city{Campinas}, \country{Brazil}}}
\affil[ ]{\orgname{PUC-SP (MSc in Biomaterials and Regenerative Medicine)}, \orgaddress{\city{São Paulo}, \country{Brazil}}}
\orcid{0000-0002-8596-5097}

\keywords{philosophy of science, structural analogy, complex systems, fractals, entropy, quantum-like models, socio-symbolic dynamics, methodology}

\abstract{
We advance a formal--analogical framework that conceives social organization as an \emph{entropically driven fractal dynamics}. A symbolic Schr\"odinger--like representation uses a normative potential \(V(x)\) and a symbolic mass \(m_s\); the wavefunction \(\psi_s(x,t)\) induces densities \(|\psi_s|^2\) on a socio--symbolic space. The quantum apparatus is treated as a \emph{structural analogy}---not a physical mechanism. We articulate falsifiable signatures (scaling exponents, cascade statistics, order--effects), outline estimation of \(V(x)\) and \(m_s\), and present a SWOW--style proof--of--concept. A reproducible ``Supplementary Methods --- Figure Generation'' script accompanies the submission.
}

\begin{document}
\maketitle

\section{Introduction}\label{sec:intro}
We propose a structural--analogical formalism to model socio--symbolic dynamics via \(\psi_s(x,t)\) evolving under \(V(x)\) and \(m_s\), anchored in small--world/scale--free organization, SOC, and urban scaling \citep{WattsStrogatz1998,BarabasiAlbert1999,Bak1987,Bettencourt2007,West1997}, and aligned with accounts of models/analogies \citep{Hesse1966,Cartwright1983,FriggHartmannSEP}.

\section{Method and Epistemic Status}\label{sec:method}
\begin{equation}
i\hbar\,\partial_t \psi_s = \Big[-\frac{\hbar^2}{2m_s}\nabla^2 + V(x)\Big]\psi_s,\qquad x\in X.
\end{equation}
\(|\psi_s|^2\) is a density of manifestation; \(V(x)\) encodes normative constraints; \(m_s\) encodes identity inertia. Mapping (QM$\to$Social): \(\psi\to\psi_s\), \(|\psi|^2\to|\psi_s|^2\), \(V(x)\to\) normative field, interference\(\to\)non-additivity, tunnelling\(\to\)improbable transitions.

\section{Testable Signatures}\label{sec:signatures}
\begin{center}\begin{tabular}{lll}\toprule
Variable & Signature & Metric/Operationalization\\\midrule
\(m_s\) & slower trajectories; rigidity & path entropy; embedding drift; Hurst exponent\\
\(V(x)\) & alignment; confinement; tunnelling & GP/regression for \(V\); CUSUM/PELT; transition hazard\\
\(|\psi_s|^2\) & high-density pockets; non-additivity & cluster overlap; Jensen--Shannon divergence; order-effects\\
\(\nabla^2\) & smoothing/propagation & Laplacian; total variation; diffusion coeffs\\
SOC cascades & heavy-tailed sizes & power-law inference; LRT vs lognormal; Q--Q plots\\
Metastability & long dwell + jumps & dwell-time; change-points; sliding entropy\\
Interference & order-dependence & quantum-like decision paradigms\\\bottomrule
\end{tabular}\end{center}

\section{Estimation Blueprint}\label{sec:estimation}
Construct \(X\) via language embeddings/behavioral features; estimate \(V(x)\) with penalized regression or GPs; infer \(m_s\) from identity persistence and dwell times; validate against diffusion baselines.

\section{Proof-of-Concept (SWOW-style)}\label{sec:poc}
Minimal SWOW-style subset shows rank--frequency heavy-tail-like structure and salient cue\(\rightarrow\)response links. Figures~\ref{fig:wave3d}--\ref{fig:rankfreq} reproduced by the Supplementary Methods script.

\section{Objections and Limits}\label{sec:limits}
No physical reduction claimed; analogy is structural. Identifiability requires longitudinal data; note ethics and dataset licenses.

\section{Conclusion}\label{sec:conclusion}
A disciplined mapping from quantum formalism to socio--symbolic dynamics with falsifiable signatures and a practicable estimation path.
